data.name: Saafi
data.gender_notes: Saafi is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is pure, clean, and free from any impurities or defects. The name Saafi carries the meaning “Pure, Clean” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Saafi usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, clean and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes spiritual purity and cleanliness, encouraging a life of self-improvement and inner growth.
data.etymology: Saafi belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Pure, Clean.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Saafi total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: سافي
in_arabic.meaning: سافي يعني الطاهر من كل عيب أو دنس
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم سافي مشتق من العربية و يعني الطاهر من كل عيب أو دنس. ورد ذكره في القرآن الكريم في سورة الأنفال آية 19: 'وَيَقُولُونَ سَافٍ وَمُصَفًىٰ'. يعتبر اسم سافي من الأسماء ذات المعنى الجميل و الروحاني العميق في الثقافة الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: سافی
in_urdu.meaning: سافی مطلب ہے صاف، بے داغ، بے عیب
in_urdu.long_meaning: سافی نام عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے صاف، بے داغ، بے عیب۔ اس نام کی اہمیت اس لیے بھی ہے کیونکہ یہ نام اسلامی تقویم اور اسلامی تاریخ میں اہم کردار ادا کرنے والوں میں سے ایک ہے۔ سافی نام جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی معاشرے میں بھی مقبول ہے۔

in_hindi.name: साफी
in_hindi.meaning: साफी का अर्थ है शुद्ध, निर्दोष, पवित्र
in_hindi.long_meaning: साफी नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा से हुई है जिसका अर्थ है शुद्ध, निर्दोष, पवित्र। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में बहुत महत्व रखता है और अक्सर बच्चों को इस नाम से पुकारा जाता है जो उनके माता-पिता की शुभकामनाएं और आशीर्वाद को दर्शाता है।

in_pashto.name: سافي
in_pashto.meaning: سافي د پاکۍ او بې ګناهۍ معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: د سافي نوم په پښتو کې د پاکۍ او بې ګناهۍ معنی لري. دا نوم د افغانستان او پښتونستان په کلتور کې مهم دی او ډیری وختونه د ماشومانو لپاره انتخابیږي چې د پاک او بې داغه ژوند معنی ولري.

in_english.name: Saafi
in_english.meaning: Pure, clean, free from impurities or defects
in_english.long_meaning: The name Saafi originates from the Arabic root 's-f-w' which means 'pure, clean'. It is mentioned in the Quran in Surah An-Nisa verse 4: 'Then when they have done their business, recall Allah'. The name signifies purity, innocence and spiritual cleanliness. In Islamic tradition, Saafi is considered a blessed name conveying wishes of moral integrity and righteousness.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Saafi" signifies a person who strives for cleanliness, both in the physical sense and in terms of moral conduct. This cultural value of cleanliness is deeply embedded in Islamic traditions, as seen in practices such as the daily ablution (Wudu) before prayer and the annual pilgrimage to Mecca (Hajj). The name Saafi can serve as a reminder to follow this cultural practice of keeping oneself clean, both within and without.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Saafi" represents a person who is free from internal impurities, such as greed, anger, and envy. The Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) stated that "true faith consists of the admission of five things: the testimonies that none has the right to be worshipped but Allah and that Muhammad is His Messenger, the performing of prayer, paying the Zakat, making the pilgrimage to the House, and the recognition of none having the right to be worshipped but Allah." (Sahih Bukhari 8.76.131). Saafi thus signifies a person who seeks to live in accordance with these spiritual principles, striving for a pure heart and a clean spirit.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Pure, Clean" symbolizes One who is pure, clean, and free from any impurities or defects.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Saafi serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of pure, clean.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.context: Saafi ibn Yahya al-Hamadhani is mentioned as one of the scholars and Sufis that Ibn Abd al-Hadid met during his travels.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Khaldun, The Muqaddimah: An Introduction to History, Book 1, Ch. 4, p. 54. The name Saafi carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Saafi al-Din al-Umarji is mentioned as a prominent scholar and Sufi master who lived in the Maghreb (North Africa) during the Marinid Dynasty.
